time_scope: Dixon 1981 lexicon plus generated inflected training set
claim: Hayes & Wilson's 43 discussed constraints cover the phonotactic generalizations described by Dixon; the learner additionally selected 57 constraints with no direct analogue in Dixon, so those 57 require separate evidential treatment rather than automatic promotion to categorical language facts.
normalized_environment: model-only constraints require validation against corpus/support
exceptions_or_counterexamples: Some additional constraints may encode real gradient patterns, while others reflect sparse data or lexical accidents; the authors discuss this distinction.

time_scope: Dixon 1981 lexicon plus generated inflected training set
claim: The Wargamay training data deliberately excluded reduplicated forms and a handful of blatant phonotactic violations, including native exceptional cluster forms and loans/exceptional forms; these excluded items are explicit counterevidence to treating the learned grammar as an exceptionless census.

excluded: jawujngbayi 'big grey kangaroo' ([jngb] cluster; regular variant jawujmbayi)
gaagu... 'cockroach' (final obstruent; source typography distorted in extraction)
lajn 'line' (loan; initial l and final cluster)

scope: approximately 950-item Dixon vocabulary before inflectional expansion
exceptions_or_counterexamples: Source explicitly says 'a handful' and gives the forms; typography that is not safely recoverable from extraction is not normalized beyond the stated violation.

time_scope: Dixon 1981 lexicon plus generated inflected training set
claim: Appendix D preserves all 57 model-only Wargamay constraints with weights ranging from 3.91 to 0.40, ordered by descending weight; the list is staged as model output, not as 57 independently established phonotactic restrictions.
normalized_environment: 57 weighted feature-sequence penalties; status=model_output_only pending linguistic reconciliation
exceptions_or_counterexamples: No direct Dixon analogue by authors' definition; individual constraints vary in plausibility/support and should not be collapsed into categorical restrictions.
section: Appendix D: Further Constraints for Wargamay
